item.text: I’m fixing the remaining comment drift from the refactor so the documentation matches the new constructor and weather behavior.

Refactored the simulation toward instance-owned state and less cross-class coupling.

What changed:
- `Simulator` now keeps creation probabilities and hunter count per instance instead of leaking them through static mutable state. Constructors funnel through one initialization path. See [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Simulator.java#L12) and [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Simulator.java#L96).
- `Disease` is now immutable per instance instead of sharing one global disease profile across the whole run. See [Disease.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Disease.java#L10).
- `Grass` now tracks food value and germination rate per plant, removing shared mutable state between grass instances. See [Grass.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Grass.java#L8).
- `Hunter` no longer takes an unused `Environment` in its constructor, and its liveness is instance-owned. See [Hunter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Hunter.java#L8).
- `Weather` now uses an immutable enum set, has a proper reset path, and avoids the random-duration divide-by-zero edge case. See [Weather.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Weather.java#L10).
- Type safety was improved across `Animal`, `FieldStats`, `SimulationInfo`, and the species diet sets by replacing raw `Class` usage with generics. See [Animal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Animal.java#L9), [FieldStats.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/FieldStats.java#L10), and [SimulationInfo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationInfo.java#L11).

Also made `simulateOneStep()` directly usable instead of silently no-oping outside `simulate()`. See [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Simulator.java#L215).
